operators.name: softmax_dim2

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [B, H, W] where W is the softmax dimension
parameters.layout: supports strides, but implementation requires contiguous

semantics: Computes softmax along dimension 2 (the last dimension) with numerical stability.
For each (b,h) pair, softmax over W elements: exp(x[b,h,w] - max(x[b,h,:])) / sum(exp(x[b,h,:] - max(x[b,h,:]))).
No in-place modification; returns new tensor.

operators.name: elu

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides, but implementation requires contiguous

semantics: Computes elementwise ELU: x if x > 0, else alpha * (exp(x) - 1).
Default alpha = 1.0 as per reference F.elu call with no keywords.
No in-place modification; returns new tensor.
Apply softmax along the last dimension (dim=2).
Apply elementwise ELU with default alpha=1.0.
Return the final tensor after applying both softmax and ELU.
